root_adjustment: After a legacy metadata-only save succeeds but compact publication fails, an explicit migration still executes migrateAndPublish. Only the toolbar retry takes publication-only path. This prevents a misleading successful migration action with no migration. Original frozen proposal retained unchanged.
design_findings: Exact UTF8 replacement detection; unchanged nil/empty/reference representation preserved
Keychain stage and readback precede original durable row publication; no predecessor deletion
Actual current/durable row checks precede dirty UI checkpoint; stale writer fails
Built-in markers excluded from explicit targeted migration
Supported reader boundary phase1 or later; no old-binary or multi-device proof
No schema, account registry, entitlements, provider row identity or CloudKit container changes
remaining: Original Apple Security/SwiftData/extension signing and multi-device/account lifecycle acceptance; source syntax is not execution
